# Volume 2 timeline

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — While [Anne](../character/anne.md) daydreams on the doorstep, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) angrily confronts her about her cow getting into his oats. [Anne](../character/anne.md) retorts about his baldness before securing the cow, and later discusses the incident over tea with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). Mrs. Rachel shares local news, including upcoming changes in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and new students expected in Anne's classroom.

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) expresses skepticism about the [American](../codex/factions.md#american)-raised [Irving](../character/irving.md) boy coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and warns [Anne](../character/anne.md) against establishing a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). [Anne](../character/anne.md) defends her plans to improve Avonlea's appearance alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Finally, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) shares the news that Anne's former classmate, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school.

## III Mr. Harrison at Home

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md)** — While driving back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) spot a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's wet oat field and chase it into the lane. Believing the cow to be her own mischievous animal, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), an annoyed [Anne](../character/anne.md) impetuously sells it on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers her real cow still in the milking pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow. Horrified by her mistake, [Anne](../character/anne.md) packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess to Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md).

## IV Different Opinions

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), Carmody, [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), Improvement Society, Avonlea** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) nervously visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the mistake good-naturedly, accepts Anne's cow in exchange, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a pleasant conversation and bonding over cake and tea, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to happily report the successful outcome to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — On the evening before school opens, [Anne](../character/anne.md), Jane, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate their teaching methods and views on corporal punishment at a crossroads. [Anne](../character/anne.md) then walks back through her favorite spots, avoids Mrs. Lynde's unsolicited advice at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule without whipping. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne.md) is comforted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as she prepares for her first day as a teacher.

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Clarice Almira](../character/clarice-almira.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Morley, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Pyes, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) begins her first day teaching school, forgetting her prepared speech but managing her new pupils, including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and a bright, imaginative boy named [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an excessively dressed Mrs. Donnell visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. On her walk home, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) wild orchids, brightening her mood before she returns to recount her day to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) travel along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road to collect subscriptions for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) to repaint the local hall. They encounter pessimistic Miss [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), who refuses to give anything, though her sister Catherine secretly donates afterwards. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how they helped flustered Dan Blair mix a cake in exchange for a generous donation, followed by their visit to meticulous Mrs. Theodore White.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) continue canvassing neighbors for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), encountering an overly neat woman, odd locals, and an unhelpful household. Capitalizing on the birth of Lorenzo White's new son, [Anne](../character/anne.md) secures a generous five-dollar donation after admiring the newborn. Later that night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) attempts to canvass Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute any money.

## VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Mary](../character/mary.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), [Wiggins](../character/wiggins.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drops by while [Anne](../character/anne.md) is attempting to write, and they discuss their respective teaching experiences, students, and future career ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves to get a book, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her cousin Mary Keith is dying and needs someone to care for her twin children, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) successfully persuades [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the twins out of a sense of duty, agreeing to help with their sewing.

## IX A Question of Color

**Aid Society, [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Wiggins](../character/wiggins.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose playful and rowdy behavior immediately poses a challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). At church on Sunday, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates a commotion by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck during the service. Later in the week, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins Dora's dress by forcing her to walk the pigpen fence and pumps water over her, subsequently confessing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne.md) quickly retrieves the toad and carries it outside to the orchard before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can discover it. Relieved, she notices [Diana](../character/diana.md) signaling to her from her window.

## X Davy in Search of a Sensation

**[Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Timothy Cotton](../character/timothy-cotton.md), [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md), [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Hiram Sloane](../character/hiram-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Mary](../character/mary.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home through the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and meets [Diana](../character/diana.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing. After searching the well with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). After [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) breaks down in tears over his falsehoods, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reprimand him, send him to bed, and later laugh over his antics.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) speaks with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in his bedroom, explaining to him why lying and skipping his prayers leads to bad consequences. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes downstairs and laughs with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about Davy's antics, and the two discuss how best to handle and raise the mischievous boy.

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her humorous and charming experiences as a schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny classroom anecdotes, excerpts from her students' compositions, and the story of how [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied an old love letter for her assignment. Finally, she highlights a letter from her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), about his imaginative rock friends.

**[Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) writes a letter describing his imaginary friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md) of the cave. He details magical adventures, such as sailing into a moonglade and visiting the sunset land. He concludes the letter with a postscript clarifying that the stories are not real.

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Ned Clay](../character/ned-clay.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md)** — Suffering from a severe toothache, [Anne](../character/anne.md) has a disastrous and irritable day at school, accidentally throwing a package of fireworks into the stove and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. She returns home distraught over losing her temper, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next day, to Anne's surprise, Anthony shows newfound respect for her, which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) later confirms was earned through the whipping.

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Jordan](../character/jordan.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Silas Sloane](../character/silas-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) plans a spring outing with [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and Jane to celebrate an adopted spring birthday. During their walk through the woods and pastures, the girls explore unknown paths, name a woodland pool, and discover [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's forgotten garden, where [Diana](../character/diana.md) tells the romantic story of Hester's life.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends discuss [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's life and imagine her appearance while visiting her old garden. They enjoy a picnic lunch by a brook, where [Anne](../character/anne.md) leads a poetic conversation about nature, poems, and the shapes of human souls. After a pleasant afternoon wandering the woods, the girls return home at sunset with fresh flowers.

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), Improvers, [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who talks about church preparations, and upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn from a letter that the twins will stay with them until fall. [Anne](../character/anne.md) recalls a humorous interaction with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his antics and misinterpretations of the catechism. Later, at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the group is distressed to hear that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and an unsuccessful committee sent to reason with him leaves them dismayed.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Louisa Spencer](../character/louisa-spencer.md), [Levi Boulter](../character/levi-boulter.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), Improvers, [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne.md) will expose his corruption and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to cancel the ad deal to keep her quiet, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to make a deal and simply keeps the secret out of principle.

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), Improvers, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), Sunday School, Virgil** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school year and walks home, meeting young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) on her way to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) cemetery. They discuss their loved ones, imagination, and placing flowers on graves. At the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together while discussing teaching, ideals, friendship, and future plans.

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives a letter announcing that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will visit, and she enthusiastically plans a elaborate dinner party with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md). After clearing up Davy's confused ideas about heaven and preparing the house and food, [Anne](../character/anne.md) secures Davy's promise to behave during the upcoming visit.

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) excitedly prepare a elaborate dinner and floral decorations at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a guest, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, chaos ensues when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins the lemon pies, the peas are ruined by being oversweetened by too many cooks, and Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up. To cap off the disastrous day, Miss Barry's expensive platter is accidentally smashed, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) later receives a letter explaining Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) injured her ankle.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Isabella Andrews](../character/isabella-andrews.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and cannot visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) sit together in the evening discussing the day's mishaps, how to replace Miss Barry's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). As they finish talking, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks up the lane.

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne.md) about sleep and Marilla's frugality before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) calls [Anne](../character/anne.md) over to see Diana's signal. [Diana](../character/diana.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne.md) about a willow-ware platter at the [Copp](../character/copp.md) home on the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), which they decide to retrieve the following day. When they arrive at the empty [Copp](../character/copp.md) house, [Anne](../character/anne.md) climbs onto an old duck house to look through the pantry window, falls through the roof, and gets trapped. After sitting through a rainstorm while stuck, [Anne](../character/anne.md) is rescued by Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md), who agrees to entertain selling her the platter over tea.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Copp](../character/copp.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md) for looking into her pantry, and the two negotiate the purchase of the willow-ware platter. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) treats [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) to tea and bread while sharing the news that she is getting married. After successfully securing the platter, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) drive home along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), reflecting on their adventurous day.

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea, reassuring him about his imaginative thoughts and helping him feel better after a maid called him strange. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and settles his jealousy regarding [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). Later in the evening, she encounters [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and reflects on how much he has matured.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — After helping [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) with his evening prayers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) where she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). They discuss the progress of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and their upcoming school term before [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to talk with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her plans for the next day.

## XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Di](../character/di.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to do household chores while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes to help Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). While transferring bed feathers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly applies rug dye to her nose instead of freckle lotion, turning it bright red just before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) wash off the dye and supplies a roast chicken, allowing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to successfully entertain her visitors with a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolhouse antics and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) scares her with stories of her deceased relatives. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) take a walk through the woods and accidentally lose their way while heading to a tea party. Their wrong turn leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they meet the eccentric Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), who invite them to stay for a pretend tea party.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young servant, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), in her house and garden. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's magical echoes and explains how all her young helpers ended up named [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md). Before the girls leave, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), which briefly brings a subtle change and quiet sadness over Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) as they say goodbye.

## XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — During breakfast, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the situation with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), all while managing Davy's lively table manners. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to help [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) make an [Indian](../codex/factions.md#indian) headdress using old feathers. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund that ensures the twins can remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and they spend an enjoyable evening sharing stories, tea, and candy. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) opens up about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to suggest bringing his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), for a visit. A month later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) introduces [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two quickly form a warm and fond connection.

## XXV An Avonlea Scandal

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md)** — After anonymous newspaper notes predict a severe storm, an unusually devastating hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and windows. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins shelter through the tempest, later learning that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed and an eyesore house was struck by lightning. Neighbors assess the ruin, and [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md) basks in his newly acquired fame as a prophet.

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [James A](../character/james-a.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's long-lost wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived at his house. The news spreads quickly through the neighborhood, with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigating the situation. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who admits he is glad his wife has returned and prepares to explain their past separation.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) how he and his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), originally separated over housecleaning habits and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), leading to their eventual reconciliation. [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns and warmly welcomes [Anne](../character/anne.md), after which [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) are present.

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md)** — Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's passing, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) come to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne](../character/anne.md) can attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts the opportunity with mixed emotions and resigns her teaching post, prompting reactions from her pupils and [Diana](../character/diana.md).

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana.md) expresses sadness about [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) clarifies that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is strictly a friend and describes her idealized view of love. The two girls discuss local gossip regarding [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong affection for each other.

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — During dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her outfit and shares stories from school while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tries to keep him in line. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). While [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes and talks about his grandmother's strict rules, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) chat before [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes strawberry picking with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), England, [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholy behavior to [Anne](../character/anne.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to promise to return for a extended visit to cheer her up. After a outdoors tea with strawberries, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) sits with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in the garden and shares stories about her imaginary dream-boy, which resonates deeply with Paul's own imagination before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [William Bell](../character/william-bell.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Gracie](../character/gracie.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md)** — After school finishes for the year, town mothers discuss Anne's departure for college, the upcoming loss of Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's unique imagination. [Anne](../character/anne.md) stays at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), then meets [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and learns he wants to reconnect with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly helps arrange their reunion, helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to see Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) lets him in to reunite with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) wait anxiously in the kitchen until they see [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking together outside with his arm around her, confirming their reconciliation.

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a busy month helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her upcoming wedding and discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) professing their love for each other in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. The next evening, [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on love and her own imagined future.

## Chapter 32

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to help [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden in front of their guests, after which everyone sees them off at the station. While locking up the stone house afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, poignant moment that subtly alters the nature of their relationship as they look toward their college years.
